trust_decision.summary: Whether a caller-supplied filesystem path may be opened for reading is decided entirely in the context_import case of the single CallTool dispatcher in src/index.ts, which passes args.filePath straight to fs.readFileSync with no validation and no helper call.

landing_point.why: An engineer reading only the summary ('context_import via unvalidated filePath') opens the context_import case and finds the single fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf8') fed directly from args, inside one monolithic handler file.

fix_sites.module_kind: validation utility module (existing but unwired helper)

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Importing the file that context_export itself just wrote must keep working: export writes to os.tmpdir()/memory-keeper-export-<sid8>.json and the README documents importing that exported file and user backup paths. A fix that confines reads to the data directory or cwd (or that only allows paths inside the project) breaks the documented export-to-import roundtrip.

O6_input_shapes: non-string JSON value for filePath (array/number/object), which validateFilePath rejects by its typeof check (src/utils/validation.ts:12)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: context_cache_file could read the file from disk when content is omitted (a 'cache this file' convenience) instead of only storing caller-supplied content.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It already takes a filePath plus content pair and its schema advertises 'Path to the file', so making content optional and reading filePath is a natural maintainer change that recreates the same unvalidated read.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: loadConfigFile reads a configurable path (TOOL_PROFILE_CONFIG) with no path validation and logs the raw JSON.parse error message.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The same fs.readFileSync(path) + JSON.parse + raw error.message pattern already exists in a second module, and a maintainer could harden it with the same path check or expose it as a tool argument.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: context_export writing to an optional user-supplied outputPath rather than a generated os.tmpdir() name.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Export and import are a symmetric pair in the same dispatcher, and EXAMPLES.md:985 already shows an outputPath argument to the export workflow, so a maintainer could add it.

O9_family: CWE-22 path traversal / arbitrary local file read, with CWE-209 error-message information exposure

O10_build.toolchain: Node.js >=20.0.0, tsc (npm run build -> dist/index.js), jest + ts-jest, better-sqlite3 native module (prebuilt for Node 20/22/24), eslint/prettier
O10_build.project_tests: ~1185 jest tests; context_import itself is only exercised by simulated tests that never call the handler (src/__tests__/integration/export-import.test.ts:204-307); the e2e suites spawn the built server over stdio (src/__tests__/e2e/server-e2e.test.ts:143), which is the harness a hidden behavioural test would use; validateFilePath is unit-tested (src/__tests__/utils/validation.test.ts:22-62)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Call the already-present validateFilePath(filePath, 'read') helper (src/utils/validation.ts:11) and stop: it is a blocklist that only rejects .., /etc/, /sys/, /proc/, /Windows/ and /System32/, so /root/.ssh/id_rsa or any absolute path outside those directories still reads.
